checkpoints.description: Task 'keystone-v1' completed successfully.
[1/6] Plan: sim core -> procedural terrain -> dungeon generator -> expedition/collision -> vertex-color renderer + seed CLI -> AI harness, docs and gates

impact_assessment.why: Make the extracted world/simulation capabilities the engine core, not demo packs: a seeded expedition loop proves deterministic generation, collision, first-person rendering and AI playability.
impact_assessment.benefits: One reproducible seed drives terrain, dungeon, player state and hash; the sim is renderer-independent and testable headlessly; Aldervale/Crypt-Crawler/Dustline algorithms become reusable engine systems.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: MeshData gains optional vertex colors and Engine.run gains a controls callback; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: single-threaded fixed-step; state: seeded generation and replay hash must stay stable.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Fail-first tests for colors, determinism, collision and mode transitions; ADR for the core contract; renderer integration test and headless screenshot; ports are modular, no monolith pasted.

checkpoints.description: [6/6] Seeded expedition core complete: 134 tests, 6/6 gates, visible 30-frame dogfood, harness selftest green (determinism, seed sensitivity, portal entry/exit), 120 frames at 1280x720 in ~4.0 s wall-clock; checklists: passed

handoff.evidence: pytest 134 passed, aikit check 6/6, strict check pending clean commit

checkpoints.description: Task 'keystone-expedition-v1' completed successfully.
[1/4] Plan: combat data + deterministic director -> world integration (spawn/waves/damage/death/hash) -> enemy scene nodes + status title -> docs, harness and gates

impact_assessment.why: The expedition has exploration but no threat; combat is the missing core gameplay mechanic and Dustline provides the proven archetype/wave model.
impact_assessment.benefits: Turns the seeded expedition into a survival loop, exercises collision/AI/hash headlessly, and gives the harness combat state without a GPU.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: World snapshot/hash and step gain combat state; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: single-thread fixed-step; state: spawn RNG and death/reset must stay deterministic.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Frozen enemy/weapon tables, seeded director tests, deterministic replay hash, scene-sync tests and a headless combat screenshot.

checkpoints.description: Superseded by 'keystone-lightlock-v1' without --complete or --reset
[1/4] Plan: LightLock tracer + seeded mirror puzzle -> world gate/hash/interaction -> portal beams, mirrors and dye scene -> docs, tests and gates

impact_assessment.why: The portal currently opens unconditionally; a deterministic light-routing puzzle adds the Iris core mechanic and a reason to explore the new beam/mirror vocabulary.
impact_assessment.benefits: Gives the expedition a spatial puzzle, exercises color-mask ray tracing and interaction, and remains fully headless/replayable.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: World snapshot/hash and interact gain light-lock state; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: single-thread; state: seeded mirror orientations and solved state must not make the puzzle unsolvable.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Force an unsolved initial state, test solution/wrong/cycle paths, gate only the portal, and verify hash/harness determinism.

handoff.state: LightLock and rotate action frozen for v0.4.0

checkpoints.description: Task 'keystone-lightlock-v1' completed successfully.
[1/4] Plan: Hamiltonian weave generator + tests -> World layout selection/hash -> thread-colored dungeon floors + CLI/harness layout flag -> docs, ADR and gates

impact_assessment.why: Weft's guaranteed-coverage route generator adds a second deterministic dungeon topology and makes the weave mechanic visible in the 3D world.
impact_assessment.benefits: Every room is connected exactly once, layouts vary by seed, and the route/thread data stays headless and replayable.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: World gains a layout field and weave metadata in snapshot/hash; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: single-thread; state: generated path/segments must remain valid and deterministic.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate path uniqueness/orthogonality/coverage, segment partition and dungeon reachability; force auto-layout tests for both branches; visual floor-color test and screenshot.

checkpoints.description: [4/4] Weave layout complete: 169 tests, 6/6 gates, Hamiltonian coverage/orthogonality/partition tests, forced and auto layout tests, 60-frame visible dogfood, weave screenshot; checklists: passed

handoff.state: WeaveLayout and --layout option frozen for v0.5.0
handoff.next: weave branches/loops or the next mechanic pack
handoff.evidence: pytest 169 passed, aikit check 6/6, strict check pending clean commit

checkpoints.description: Task 'keystone-weave-v1' completed successfully.
[1/4] Plan: seeded terminal graph + hack/alert state -> World dungeon gate/hunter response/hash -> network nodes and links in the dungeon scene -> docs, ADR and gates

impact_assessment.why: Cyberpulse's network and living-alert model gives the dungeon an objective beyond reaching the exit and makes combat respond to player actions.
impact_assessment.benefits: Every dungeon run gets a deterministic infiltration graph, a risk/reward alert clock and hunter pressure, all replayable through the harness.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: World snapshot/hash and dungeon interact gain network state; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: single-thread; state: hacking must remain reachable and exit gating must not strand a run.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Generate terminals only in reachable non-spawn/exit rooms, test graph connectivity, force completion in replay tests, and keep a sealed-exit message with the current progress.

handoff.state: Network and network-gated exit frozen for v0.6.0

checkpoints.description: Task 'keystone-network-v1' completed successfully.
[1/4] Plan: galaxy/system/orbit generation -> SpaceWorld flight, scanning and gate jumps -> SpaceExpedition scene, CLI --space and screenshot -> space harness, docs, ADR and gates

impact_assessment.why: A second playable mode proves Keystone is an engine, not a dungeon demo, and uses Voidfarer's procedural systems and survey loop.
impact_assessment.benefits: Deterministic star systems, orbiting bodies, free-flight scanning and hyperlane travel, all renderer-independent and replayable.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new SpaceWorld state/hash and CLI mode; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: single-thread; state: orbit positions and jump/scanned state must stay deterministic.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Seeded generation tests, scan/jump boundary tests, headless harness, a visible dogfood run and a space screenshot.
